image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a pipe organ facade. The image features three distinct sections of vertical metal pipes housed within ornate wooden casework. The pipes are silver-colored with a metallic sheen, varying in height to create a stepped silhouette. The wood is a warm reddish-brown with visible grain and decorative molding. In the lower right foreground, a portion of the console or stop jamb is visible, featuring rows of small, rectangular stop tabs or knobs with labels. The lighting is somewhat dim, creating shadows within the pipe recesses.
